# Search for ANY post-May-2 chunked dist-renderer (163+ js files or AdaptiveLayoutEngine-*.js chunk)
$cutoff = Get-Date '2026-05-02 23:59:59'
$searchRoots = @('C:\Users\KickA\Projects','C:\Users\KickA\Documents\GitHub',"$env:APPDATA\neuralshell-v5")
$chunkedBuilds = @()
foreach ($root in $searchRoots) {
  Get-ChildItem $root -Recurse -Directory -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
    Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'js' -and $_.Parent.Name -eq 'dist-renderer' -and $_.FullName -match 'NeuralShell|neuralshell' } |
    ForEach-Object {
      $jsCount = (Get-ChildItem $_.FullName -Filter '*.js' -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Count
      $adaptive = Get-ChildItem $_.FullName -Filter 'AdaptiveLayoutEngine-*.js' -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
      $index = Get-ChildItem $_.FullName -Filter 'index-*.js' -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1
      if ($jsCount -gt 10 -or $adaptive) {
        $parent = $_.Parent.Parent.FullName
        $chunkedBuilds += [PSCustomObject]@{
          JsCount=$jsCount
          HasAdaptiveChunk=($null -ne $adaptive)
          IndexBundle=$index.Name
          IndexHash=if($index){(Get-FileHash $index.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.Substring(0,16)}else{'n/a'}
          DirDate=$_.LastWriteTime
          AfterMay2=($_.LastWriteTime -gt $cutoff)
          Path=$parent
        }
      }
    }
}
Write-Output "Chunked dist-renderer builds found: $($chunkedBuilds.Count)"
$chunkedBuilds | Sort-Object DirDate -Descending | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 500

# LOCKED GOOD UI — v2.1.32 (May 2 build)

**Locked:** 2026-05-17  
**Purpose:** Immutable reference for renderer recovery. Do not overwrite or delete.

## Visual fingerprint (confirmed)

- `SUN • 05/17/26` (clock/date top-right)
- Layout presets: HUD / Dense / Standard / Spacious
- Control Deck, Operator Hero Console
- `v2.1.32` top-left
- Chunked renderer: `index-CDfqmjqJ.js` + `AdaptiveLayoutEngine-*.js`

## Artifact hashes

| Artifact | SHA256 |
|----------|--------|
| `NeuralShell Setup 2.1.32.exe` | `F54ADAC2735963852607B12042A5E10DE2F591F7B8F7B06D42E1C72EE10F6668` |
| `app.asar` (May 2, 661 MB) | `763E5C9D0BE2576F0B5CDF18AD9B5860447BFEA9F2072873124726C901A08124` |
| `index-CDfqmjqJ.js` (chunked main bundle) | `1671550E6E72A241246AC6EC08929768D768CA5F4F6D36507FD0485C64B64968` |
| `neuralshell-232-main-shell-20260517.png` | `271B378A24C7CC3499F3298F5BA9CE988B34E15493326001969FFF6C94A729FE` |

## Bad UI (do not use as baseline)

| Artifact | SHA256 | Notes |
|----------|--------|-------|
| `index-DRb2Vx79.js` | `DFBB3D794FF4BA38B56E121D43B2FEE280E2D0F6B6F2A713FB435565462A3FF8` | May 17 monolithic |
| `index-T88aDAK2.js` | `EA8C380BB37B6109461AC2FD03B7433A1CCDFE6F7EE62246CDC02F9B963A0025` | PR68 |
| `index-CyhV27Wm.js` | `C22F34A3F191F5F925BB954AAEBED27852474EA7812FF78F8C3352F51FCAB3EA` | Stale March |

## Canonical paths

- Installer: `release\final\bin\NeuralShell Setup 2.1.32.exe`
- Recovery source: `validation-artifacts\ui-recovery\asar-full-release-232\src\renderer\`
- Screenshot: `neuralshell-232-main-shell-20260517.png`

## Known May 2 one-line bug (not applied)

**File:** `asar-full-release-232\src\renderer\src\components\SetupScreen.jsx` line 2

```js
// From:
import { Sparkles, Shield, HardDrive, Zap, ArrowRight, ChevronLeft } from 'lucide-react';
// To:
import { Sparkles, Shield, HardDrive, Zap, ArrowRight, ChevronLeft, Cpu } from 'lucide-react';
```

Fresh installs hit `ReferenceError: Cpu is not defined` on setup step 1 until fixed.

# Renderer recovery plan — port v2.1.32 UI forward

**Status:** Plan only. No source edits applied yet.  
**Baseline:** `LOCKED-GOOD-UI-232` / `asar-full-release-232\src\renderer\`  
**Target branch:** `feat/ui-refresh-private-delivery-shell` (or dedicated `feat/renderer-recovery-232`)

---

## Goal

Port the **confirmed May 2 v2.1.32 renderer architecture** into current `src/renderer/` while preserving:

1. **Packaging truth** — `package:product` must rebuild `dist-renderer` before electron-builder (no stale committed bundle).
2. **Collab port fail-safe** — keep `c85705e` collab wiring in `App.jsx` / `WorkspacePanel.jsx` / `TopStatusBar.jsx`.
3. **Current main-process fixes** — do not revert IPC, integrity, or non-renderer changes from recent work.

**Do not use as design baseline:** `index-CyhV27Wm`, `index-DRb2Vx79`, `index-T88aDAK2`.

---

## Architecture delta (good vs bad)

| Aspect | Good (v2.1.32) | Bad (current May 17) |
|--------|----------------|----------------------|
| Build | Vite **chunked** (~163 JS files) | **Monolithic** single `index-*.js` |
| Shell | `AdaptiveLayoutEngine` + regions | First-Boot Authority funnel shell |
| Top chrome | `TopStatusBar` + clock/date | Different status model |
| Layout | `LayoutControlBar` (HUD/Dense/Standard/Spacious) | Absent or different |
| Entry | `OperationsCoreLayer` / `PrimaryWorkspaceRegion` | Flattened monolith |

---

## Recovery source map (May 2 → current)

Copy or three-way-merge **from recovery source** into `src/renderer/src/`:

### Tier 1 — shell spine (must match visual fingerprint)

| Recovery file | Role |
|---------------|------|
| `components/AdaptiveLayoutEngine.jsx` | Layout orchestration |
| `components/LayoutControlBar.jsx` | HUD/Dense/Standard/Spacious |
| `components/TopStatusBar.jsx` | Clock/date, nav, model strip |
| `components/OperationsCoreLayer.jsx` | Core workspace shell |
| `components/PrimaryWorkspaceRegion.jsx` | Main region |
| `components/MultiWorkspace.jsx` | Workspace tabs/rails |
| `hooks/useAdaptiveLayoutChrome.js` | Layout chrome state |
| `App.jsx` | Shell composition (merge carefully) |

### Tier 2 — hero / deck (visual proof markers)

| Recovery file | Role |
|---------------|------|
| `components/WorkspacePanel.jsx` | Chat/workspace (merge collab props from current) |
| `components/FirstBootWizard.jsx` | Onboarding (if still desired) |
| `components/SetupScreen.jsx` | First-run (+ **Cpu import fix**) |

### Tier 3 — build config

| Recovery file | Role |
|---------------|------|
| `vite.config.js` (or equivalent) | Ensure **code-splitting** matches May 2 (not single-bundle override) |
| `package.json` (renderer) | Align deps only where needed for layout components |

---

## Merge rules (collab + packaging)

### Collab (`c85705e` fail-safe)

When merging `App.jsx`, `WorkspacePanel.jsx`, `TopStatusBar.jsx`:

- **Keep from current:** `useCollabRoom`, `collab.publish`, `remoteCursors`, `collabConnected`, `collabPeerCount`, `collabRoomId`.
- **Take from recovery:** layout structure, status bar layout, clock/date, layout presets, `AdaptiveLayoutEngine` tree.
- **Verify:** collab props still passed through `AdaptiveLayoutEngine` → `PrimaryWorkspaceRegion` → `WorkspacePanel`.

### Packaging truth

Before any release candidate:

```powershell
# Must produce chunked dist-renderer, NOT monolithic DRb2Vx79
npm run build --prefix src/renderer
# Verify: dist-renderer/js/ has many chunks + index-CDfqmjqJ-style hash/name
# Then package:product (only when instructed)
```

Add CI guard (later): fail if `dist-renderer/assets/index-DRb2Vx79.js` or single-file bundle > 900KB without chunk dir.

---

## Phased execution

### Phase 0 — Lock & branch (done / next)

- [x] Lock installer + screenshot → `LOCKED-GOOD-UI-232/`
- [ ] Create branch `feat/renderer-recovery-232` from current HEAD
- [ ] Tag recovery source commit reference in branch message

### Phase 1 — Renderer spine import

1. Copy Tier 1 files from recovery source into `src/renderer/src/`.
2. Apply **Cpu import fix** in `SetupScreen.jsx` (one line).
3. Fix import paths / missing deps vs current tree.
4. `npm run build --prefix src/renderer` — confirm **chunked** output.

### Phase 2 — App.jsx three-way merge

1. Diff recovery `App.jsx` vs current `App.jsx`.
2. Restore `AdaptiveLayoutEngine` wrapper and layout state.
3. Re-wire collab hooks from current into recovery shell.
4. Dev smoke: `npm run dev` (renderer) — visual check vs screenshot.

### Phase 3 — Workspace + panels

1. Merge `WorkspacePanel.jsx` (recovery layout + current collab).
2. Restore `OperationsCoreLayer` / hero console if split in recovery.
3. Visual regression against `neuralshell-232-main-shell-20260517.png`.

### Phase 4 — Packaging validation (only when instructed)

1. Run `package:product` once.
2. Verify installed `app.asar` contains chunked `dist-renderer/js/`.
3. Hash compare main bundle — must **not** be `DRb2Vx79`.
4. Install to test machine; confirm no integrity/setup blockers for dev.

---

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Built renderer shows clock/date top-right (`SUN • …` pattern).
- [ ] Layout presets HUD/Dense/Standard/Spacious visible and functional.
- [ ] Control Deck + Operator Hero Console present in default view.
- [ ] `index-*.js` main chunk hash ≠ `DRb2Vx79`, build is chunked (multiple files in `dist-renderer/js/`).
- [ ] Fresh install completes setup without `Cpu` error (after one-line fix).
- [ ] Collab still connects and publishes cursors (c85705e behavior preserved).
- [ ] `package:product` produces installer; post-install UI matches locked screenshot fingerprint.

---

## Out of scope (this recovery)

- Redesigning UI from `DRb2Vx79` / PR68 baselines
- Reverting main-process changes unrelated to renderer
- Publishing a release until visual + packaging acceptance pass

content.text:
## Version downgrade — root cause

Your read is correct. The installer label comes from **package metadata at build time**, not from “whatever UI was running.”

```text
Installed good app:     2.1.32  (May 2 artifact, chunked UI)
May 17 package:product: 2.1.29  (current repo metadata + bad monolithic UI)
Result:                 looked like a downgrade + UI regression
```

---

## Where installer version comes from

| Source | Value | Used for installer? |
|--------|--------|---------------------|
| **Root `package.json` → `version`** | **`2.1.29`** | **Yes — primary** |
| `package-lock.json` (root) | `2.1.29` | Lockfile sync with root |
| `src/renderer/package.json` → `version` | `2.0.0` | **No** — renderer sub-package only |
| `electron-builder` config | In root `package.json` → `"build"` | No separate `version`; inherits root |
| `scripts/package-product-release.ps1` | `Get-PackageVersion` reads root `package.json` | Staging/docs/ZIP naming |
| `app-update.yml` (in packaged app) | No version field | Update URL only |

There is **no** `electron-builder.yml` / `electron-builder.json`. electron-builder uses the root npm `version` by default, which produces:

`dist/NeuralShell Setup <version>.exe`

`package:product` flow:

1. Read version from root `package.json`
2. `npm run dist` → `electron-builder` (same version)
3. Stage `NeuralShell Setup 2.1.29.exe` (on current branch)

**UI version display** (when TopStatusBar is wired):

```10:10:src/renderer/src/components/TopStatusBar.jsx
import { version as APP_VERSION } from '../../../../package.json';
```

That resolves to **root** `package.json`, not `src/renderer/package.json`.

---

## Why current builds are `2.1.29`

| Check | Current repo | May 2 good artifact |
|-------|--------------|---------------------|
| Root `package.json` | `"version": "2.1.29"` | `"version": "2.1.32"` |
| `package-lock.json` | `2.1.29` | (not compared) |
| Recovery `asar-full-release-232/package.json` | — | `2.1.32` |

**Git history on your recovery branch (`85a5fc2`):**

- **`65d7f82` (2026-04-28)** — explicit bump to `2.1.32` (“bump 2.1.32”)
- That commit is on **`chore/worktree-recovery`** / `synced/master-2026-04-03` — **not** an ancestor of `feat/renderer-recovery-232` / `feat/ui-refresh-private-delivery-shell`
- Current branch line never picked up `2.1.32`; it stayed on the `2.1.29` line (`ea56e79`, `85a5fc2`, etc.)

So May 17 `package:product` did exactly what the repo said: build **`2.1.29`** with **current** (post-revert) renderer source → monolithic `DRb2Vx79`.

UI/revert work did **not** restore the version bump. Packaging truth followed **current** `package.json`, not the locked May 2 installer.

---

## Where `2.1.32` came from

| Evidence | Detail |
|----------|--------|
| Locked installer | `release/final/bin/NeuralShell Setup 2.1.32.exe` — built **2026-05-02 22:30** |
| Packaged app metadata | Recovery `app.asar` → `package.json` **`version: "2.1.32"`** |
| Git | Bump commit **`65d7f82`** on parallel branch (`chore/worktree-recovery`), **2026-04-28** |
| Docs in that snapshot | `docs/RELEASE_NOTES_DRAFT_v2.1.32.md`, RC copy references `v2.1.32` |

`2.1.32` was a **real release bump on a different branch line**, then packaged May 2 with the **chunked** renderer (`index-CDfqmjqJ`). It was not invented by the installer filename alone.

---

## What must change so future builds are not < `2.1.32`

**Minimum (installer + in-app label):**

```text
package.json          →  "version": "2.1.33"   (recommended)
package-lock.json     →  regenerate via npm install / npm version (keep in sync)
```

**No change needed for installer version:**

- `src/renderer/package.json` (`2.0.0`) — not the electron-builder source
- `electron-builder` `build` block — no override; uses root `version`
- `app-update.yml` — no version field

**Optional / later (not blocking installer name, but avoid confusion):**

| File | Note |
|------|------|
| `src/core/profileMobility.js` | Hardcoded schema **`V2.1.29`** (recovery snapshot too) — profile bundle schema, not app semver |
| `scripts/*` with hardcoded `2.1.29.exe` paths | Release/verify scripts; update when you ship `2.1.33` |
| `governance/source_manifest.json` | Regenerated on `package:product` via `generate-source-manifest.js` |
| Recovery `clock_face_marketplace.json` | `minAppVersion: "2.1.32"` — fine to keep as floor |

---

## Should the next recovered build be `2.1.33`?

**Yes — recommended.**

| Version | Role |
|---------|------|
| **2.1.32** | Locked May 2 reference (do not rebuild as “current”) |
| **2.1.29** | Bad May 17 metadata + monolithic UI — avoid |
| **2.1.33** | First **recovery** ship: good UI port + collab fix + chunking fix + clear semver step |

Using `2.1.32` again would collide with the locked artifact and confuse installers. Using `2.1.29` again would repeat the downgrade.

---

## Summary answers

1. **Where does installer version come from?** Root **`package.json` `version`**, consumed by **electron-builder** and **`package-product-release.ps1`**.
2. **Why does current package build `2.1.29`?** That is what **`package.json` / `package-lock.json`** say on `feat/renderer-recovery-232`; the `2.1.32` bump lives on **`65d7f82`** on another branch, not merged here.
3. **Where did `2.1.32` come from?** April 28 bump on `chore/worktree-recovery`, packaged May 2 into `release/final` and locked artifact.
4. **What file to update?** **`package.json`** (and sync **`package-lock.json`**). Renderer `package.json` is unrelated to installer version.
5. **Next build `2.1.33`?** **Yes** — clean recovery semantics.

No edits made (per your instruction). When you want the bump applied, that can be a small dedicated commit on `feat/renderer-recovery-232` after UI recovery gates pass.

### 2.2 `executeSignal` — **L1904–L2332** (must remain authoritative)

Flow:

1. `input = signal || prompt`; bail if empty.
2. **`appendChat` user message** (`nextMessageId()`).
3. **`setPrompt('')`**.
4. **Audit-only gate** — blocks non-slash chat.
5. **Slash commands** (`/help`, `/proof`, `/mission`, …) — `setIsThinking(false)`; many open `show*` panels; some call `launchStdoutStream` for proof/unit-test (**L735–L754**, proof handlers ~L2200+).

   - `history = [...chatLog, { role: 'user', content: input }]`
   - **`await window.api.llm.chat(history)`** (non-streaming)

   - `setIsThinking(false)` in `finally`

- **App:** `connectionInfo` + ShellContext `model`; `executeSignal` sends full `chatLog` history to `llm.chat` (no per-message model override in freeform path).
- **MultiWorkspace panes:** Per-pane `model` in `useMultiSession` state; stream path injects portal gate + optional rules.

# Phase 1F-C2 — Adapter functions plan (plan only)

**Branch:** `feat/renderer-recovery-232`  
**Repo:** `C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell`  
**Prerequisites passed:** 1E TopStatusBar, 1F-B LayoutControlBar, **1F-C1** (`PrimaryWorkspaceRegion` import-only)  
**Parent plan:** `PHASE-1F-C-CENTER-SHELL-PLAN.md`

**Do not implement this file.** Next code slice: **1F-C2A** (App.jsx adapters/stubs only, unused).

---

## Executive summary

Phase 1F-C2 prepares **send bridging** and **prop stubs** so `PrimaryWorkspaceRegion` / `MultiWorkspace` can mount later (1F-C3+) without bypassing App’s authoritative `executeSignal` path.

**Non-negotiables:**

- `executeSignal` remains the only path for slash commands, audit-only gates, GTM panel opens, proof stdout, and global `chatLog` updates.
- **Do not** copy recovery `handleMultiWorkspaceSend` (asar `App.jsx` **L4797–L4805**) — it calls `window.api.llm.chat` directly and bypasses `executeSignal`.
- `useMultiSession` must gain `preferAppSend` (1F-C2B/C) because `streamChat` exists in production and currently **never** calls `onSendMessage` (**`useMultiSession.js` L210–L311**).

**Out of scope for 1F-C2:** JSX swap, feature flag, collab bridge, `useMoodEngine` port, `usePanelManager` wiring, `index.css`, `vite.config.js`.

---

## 1. Current send source of truth

### 1.1 `chatLog` / `appendChat` (ShellContext)

| Symbol | Location | Role |
|--------|----------|------|
| `chatLog` | `App.jsx` **L259** (destructured from `useShell()`) | Global session transcript |
| `appendChat` | `App.jsx` **L260** | Append kernel/user/system messages |
| `setChatLog` | `App.jsx` **L261** | Used by `/clear` in `executeSignal` (**L1937**) |

There is **no `chatLogRef`** in current `App.jsx`. Phase 1F-C2A adds one so `handleMultiWorkspaceSend` can read the post-`executeSignal` tail without a stale closure.

### 1.2 `executeSignal` — **L1905–L2333**

Signature: `async (signal) => void` — `signal` optional; falls back to `prompt` (**L1906**).

| Step | Lines | Behavior |
|------|-------|----------|
| Empty guard | **L1907** | `if (!input.trim()) return` |
| User append | **L1909** | `appendChat({ id: nextMessageId(), role: 'user', content: input })` |
| Clear composer | **L1910** | `setPrompt('')` — only affects **global** `prompt`, not pane prompts |
| Audit-only gate | **L1915–L1931** | Blocks non-slash freeform |
| Slash branch | **L1934–L2316** | `setIsThinking(false)`; `/clear` → `setChatLog([])`; many commands open `show*` drawers; subset via `setTimeout` + `appendChat` |
| Freeform LLM | **L2319–L2332** | `setLastFreeformPrompt(input)`; `setIsThinking(true)`; `history = [...chatLog, { role: 'user', content: input }]`; **`await window.api.llm.chat(history)`**; `appendChat` **kernel**; `finally` → `setIsThinking(false)` |

**Authoritative for:** slash routing, audit-only, session `chatLog`, kernel message shape (`role: 'kernel'`).

**Does not:** stream freeform via `streamChat` (unlike `useMultiSession`).

### 1.3 `handleSend` — **L2400**

```js
const handleSend = () => executeSignal();
```

Uses global `prompt` state (**L285**). `WorkspacePanel` calls `onSend` → `handleSend` (**L2897**).

### 1.4 `handleRegenerate` — **L2335–L2338**

Re-invokes `executeSignal(lastFreeformPrompt)` — will **double-append user** if called while adapter is active on same text; only used by current `WorkspacePanel`, not MultiWorkspace in 1F-C2.

### 1.5 Supporting helpers

| Symbol | Lines | Notes |
|--------|-------|-------|
| `nextMessageId` | **L701–L705** | IDs for chat entries |
| `lastFreeformPrompt` | **L443**, set **L2319** | Regenerate path |
| `isThinking` | **L306**, toggled **L1917–L1935**, **L2320–L2331** | WorkspacePanel + future PWR |
| `prompt` / `setPrompt` | **L285** | Global composer only |

### 1.6 How `WorkspacePanel` sends

| Path | Mechanism | Lines (`WorkspacePanel.jsx`) |
|------|-----------|----------------------------|
| Send button / Enter | `runSend` → `onSend()` → `handleSend` → `executeSignal()` | **L318–L324** |
| Slash / cards | `runCommand` → `onExecute(command)` → `executeSignal(command)` | **L309–L316** |
| Thinking UI | `isThinking` prop → `StreamingBar`, disabled send | **L725**, **L834**, **L1092–L1110** |
| Errors / responses | **Not pane-local** — reads global `chatLog` prop | passed **L2893** |
| Streaming display | `StreamingBar` + message `_streaming` flags on **global** log entries | local toggle `streamingBarEnabled` |

### 1.7 How errors/streaming appear in `chatLog` today

| Mechanism | Where | Effect on `chatLog` |
|-----------|-------|---------------------|
| Freeform success | `executeSignal` **L2327** | `appendChat({ role: 'kernel', content })` |
| Freeform error | `executeSignal` **L2329** | `appendChat({ role: 'kernel', content: 'Kernel Error: …' })` |
| Slash responses | `executeSignal` **L1941–L2313** | `appendChat({ role: 'kernel', … })` |
| Proof / stdout streams | `launchStdoutStream` (called from slash handlers ~**L2200+**) | Appends streaming lines onto messages in global log |
| `WorkspacePanel` | Displays `chatLog` as-is | No separate error channel |

**Gap vs MultiWorkspace:** per-pane `chatLog` in `useMultiSession` state; `streamChat` + `_streaming` assistant rows (**`useMultiSession.js` L212–L289**). Until 1F-C3+, live UI still uses global log via `WorkspacePanel` only.

### 1.8 Collab state (send-adjacent, not in executeSignal)

| Symbol | Lines | Usage |
|--------|-------|-------|
| `collab` | **L486** | `useCollabRoom(String(workflowId \|\| 'default'))` |
| `collabPeerCount` | **L487** | Derived from `collab.remoteCursors` |
| TopStatusBar props | **L2768–L2770** | `collabConnected`, `collabRoomId`, `collabPeerCount` |
| `WorkspacePanel` | **L2907** | `collab={collab}` |
| Peer runtime events | **L892–L905** | `appendRuntimeEvent` on join/leave |

---

## 2. Needed adapter: `handleMultiWorkspaceSend`

### 2.1 Contract (matches `useMultiSession` `onSendMessage`)

```ts
// Called from useMultiSession.sendMessage when preferAppSend OR !canStream
async (paneId: string, text: string, pane?: Pane) => Promise<string>
```

- **`paneId` / `pane`:** ignored for global send in 1F-C2; reserved for future per-pane model routing.
- **Return:** assistant text for pane UI (**`useMultiSession.js` L293–L296**); empty string acceptable for slash-only flows that only update global log.

### 2.2 Required behavior

| Rule | Implementation |
|------|----------------|
| Must call `executeSignal` | `await executeSignal(trimmed)` — pass text so global `prompt` need not be set |
| Must not call `llm.chat` / `streamChat` directly | No `window.api.llm.*` in adapter |
| Empty text | `if (!trimmed) return ''` before `executeSignal` |
| No double-append to **global** `chatLog` | `executeSignal` already appends user (**L1909**); adapter must **not** call `appendChat` for user |
| Read response after await | Use `chatLogRef.current` (see §2.3) |

### 2.3 `chatLogRef` pattern

Insert near other refs (e.g. after **L443** or immediately above adapter block ~**L2400**):

```js
const chatLogRef = React.useRef(chatLog);
React.useEffect(() => { chatLogRef.current = chatLog; }, [chatLog]);
```

After `await executeSignal(trimmed)`:

```js
const log = Array.isArray(chatLogRef.current) ? chatLogRef.current : [];
const lastReply = [...log].reverse().find(
  (m) => m && (m.role === 'kernel' || m.role === 'assistant')
);
return String(lastReply?.content || '');
```

**Why:** `executeSignal` closes over `chatLog` at call time for LLM history (**L2322**), but the **new** kernel line is visible only after state flush; ref reads latest committed log.

### 2.4 Double-append / divergence risks

| Layer | Risk | Mitigation in plan |
|-------|------|---------------------|
| Global `chatLog` | Duplicate user if adapter also `appendChat` | Adapter never appends user |
| Pane `chatLog` | Hook **always** prepends user to pane before `onSendMessage` (**L197–L201**) | Accept until dual-write; pane ≠ global |
| Global `prompt` | `executeSignal(trimmed)` still runs `setPrompt('')` (**L1910**) | Harmless for pane composer (pane uses own `prompt`) |
| Slash commands | Hook `resolveLocalSlashCommand` (**L39–L88**) handles subset locally and **bypasses** `executeSignal` | **1F-C2B:** when `preferAppSend`, skip local slash resolution and delegate to `onSendMessage` |
| `/clear` | Hook clears pane only; `executeSignal` clears global | With `preferAppSend`, delegate `/clear` to adapter → `executeSignal` |
| `isThinking` | Hook sets pane `isThinking`; App sets global `isThinking` | Map PWR `isThinking={isThinking}` from App (**L306**) — already aligned for backdrop |

```js
const chatLogRef = React.useRef(chatLog);
React.useEffect(() => { chatLogRef.current = chatLog; }, [chatLog]);

const handleMultiWorkspaceSend = React.useCallback(async (_paneId, text) => {
  const trimmed = String(text ?? '').trim();
  if (!trimmed) return '';
  await executeSignal(trimmed);
  const log = Array.isArray(chatLogRef.current) ? chatLogRef.current : [];
  const lastReply = [...log].reverse().find(
    (m) => m && (m.role === 'kernel' || m.role === 'assistant')
  );
  return String(lastReply?.content || '');
}, [executeSignal]);
```

```js
export function useMultiSession({ onSendMessage, preferAppSend = false } = {}) {
  // inside sendMessage:

    !preferAppSend &&
```

# Phase 1F-C3C — Send-path verification and minimal fixes (plan only)

**Branch:** `feat/renderer-recovery-232`  
**Repo:** `C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell`  
**Prerequisites:** 1F-C3B visual PASS (recovery center renders); `/help` smoke **mismatch** (pane showed NodeChain/vault text, not Operator Guide)

**Do not implement this file.** Next slice: **1F-C3C instrumentation** (temporary logs), then **1F-C3C-fix** (minimal adapter timing fix).

---

## Executive summary

The 1F-C3B `/help` mismatch is **unlikely** to be caused by recovery-local slash (`resolveLocalSlashCommand`) or `streamChat` when `preferAppSend={true}` — wiring is correct on paper.

**Most likely cause:** `handleMultiWorkspaceSend` reads `chatLogRef` **immediately after** `await executeSignal(trimmed)`, but slash commands in `executeSignal` append kernel text inside **`setTimeout(..., 400)`** and return without waiting. The adapter therefore returns a **stale** last `kernel` message — often **NodeChain vault prompt** from App global listener, not the Operator Guide.

**Secondary factor:** App listens for `neuralshell:prompt-vault-save` and appends kernel text (**App.jsx L1390–1401**). NodeChain rules fire on `provider.sweep.passed` during runtime refresh (common on dev boot).

---

## 1. What actually happened on `/help` (investigation)

### 1.1 Question checklist

| Question | Answer (current code + 1F-C3B evidence) |
|----------|----------------------------------------|
| Did `preferAppSend=true` reach `useMultiSession`? | **Yes** — App PWR branch passes `preferAppSend={true}` (**App.jsx L2912**); MultiWorkspace passes to hook (**MultiWorkspace.jsx L704, L711**). |
| Did `useMultiSession` call `onSendMessage`? | **Almost certainly yes** — preferAppSend early branch (**useMultiSession.js L183–211**) calls `onSendMessage` when defined; 1F-C3B pane showed user `/help` + assistant line (not local `/help` markdown from hook L45–58). |
| Did `handleMultiWorkspaceSend` call `executeSignal`? | **Yes** — only path that updates global `chatLog` user row + triggers slash handling; user message appeared in pane. |
| Did `executeSignal` produce Operator Guide in global log? | **Eventually (likely)** — `/help` uses `setTimeout` 400ms (**App.jsx L1972–1977**); may appear in global log after adapter already returned. |
| Did recovery-local slash run? | **No** when `preferAppSend` — branch returns before `resolveLocalSlashCommand` (**useMultiSession.js L214**). |
| Did `streamChat` run? | **No** when `preferAppSend` — early return before `canStream` (**L241+**). |
| What produced pane assistant text? | **`handleMultiWorkspaceSend` return value** → pane `assistant` row (**useMultiSession.js L197–201**), sourced from **last** `kernel`/`assistant` in `chatLogRef` at read time — matched **NodeChain vault** copy (**App.jsx L1395**). |

### 1.2 Text provenance

| Text | Source file:lines |
|------|-------------------|
| Operator Guide (`### NeuralShell Operator Guide`) | `executeSignal` `/help` → `appendChat` in `setTimeout` **App.jsx L1973–1977** |
| `NodeChain prompted a vault save...` | `onPromptVaultSave` listener **App.jsx L1390–1396**; dispatched via NodeChain `promptVaultSave` handler **L1258–1259**; rule `provider.sweep.passed` in **nodechain_starter_rules.json L3–10** |

**Conclusion:** Pane showed **App-level kernel text**, but **wrong message** due to **timing/selection**, not recovery-local slash or direct `llm.chat`.

### 1.3 Sequence diagram (likely 1F-C3B `/help`)

```
Pane Enter /help
  → ms.sendMessage (preferAppSend)
  → handleMultiWorkspaceSend
  → executeSignal('/help')
       → appendChat user (global)
       → setTimeout 400ms → appendChat Operator Guide  [NOT AWAITED]
       → executeSignal returns
  → chatLogRef read → reverse.find last kernel
       → picks older "NodeChain prompted a vault save..." (or empty → '…')
  → pane chatLog += user + assistant(vault text)

~400ms later: Operator Guide lands in global chatLog only (pane not updated)
```

---

## 2. Files and lines to inspect (implementation)

| File | Lines | Why |
|------|-------|-----|
| `src/renderer/src/hooks/useMultiSession.js` | **91**, **183–211**, **214–238** | preferAppSend branch; local slash bypass |
| `src/renderer/src/components/MultiWorkspace.jsx` | **703–711**, **366–371**, **552–565** | prop threading; Enter → `ms.sendMessage` |
| `src/renderer/src/components/PrimaryWorkspaceRegion.jsx` | **37–38**, **120–124** | `onSendMessage`, `preferAppSend` forward |
| `src/renderer/src/App.jsx` | **273**, **2911–2912**, **2433–2446** | flag branch props; adapter |
| `src/renderer/src/App.jsx` | **1936–1977**, **2319–2332** | `executeSignal` slash vs freeform |
| `src/renderer/src/App.jsx` | **1286–1313**, **1390–1401**, **1258–1259** | NodeChain + vault kernel append |
| `src/renderer/src/hooks/useMultiSession.js` | **39–88** | Local `/help` content (only when `preferAppSend=false`) |

---

## 3. Temporary instrumentation plan (do not implement yet)

Add **removable** `console.info` markers (grep `recovery-send` before merge). Gate with:


| `useMultiSession.js` start of `preferAppSend` block (~L183) | `[recovery-send] preferAppSend branch { id, text }` |

# Phase 1F-C-COLLAB-PEER — Real two-window peer test plan (plan only)

**Branch:** `feat/renderer-recovery-232`  
**Repo:** `C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell`  
**Prerequisites:** COLLAB-A/B/C/D complete; `USE_RECOVERY_CENTER_SHELL` default `false`

**Parent:** `PHASE-1F-C-COLLAB-PLAN.md`, `phase-1f-collab-d-smoke/`

**Do not run this test in the planning task.** This document is the execution plan only.

---

## Executive summary

COLLAB-D proved the recovery-center collab **bridge does not crash** with empty `remoteCursors`. It did **not** prove:

- WebSocket connection to the in-process collab signal server
- Remote cursor dots visible cross-window
- TopStatusBar peer count reflecting remote peers

**Root cause in dev harness:** `src/main.js` injects CSP with `connect-src 'none'` when `NODE_ENV !== "development"` (dist/electron `.` launch used by Playwright). In development, `connect-src` allows Vite only (`ws://localhost:5173`), **not** `ws://127.0.0.1:55116` where `useCollabRoom` connects (`useCollabRoom.ts` L32–36).

**Recommended path:** Single Electron process, **two BrowserWindows**, shared collab server on `127.0.0.1:55116`, temporary **test-only** CSP env gate, `USE_RECOVERY_CENTER_SHELL=true` only for the run, evidence under `validation-artifacts/ui-recovery/phase-1f-collab-peer-test/`.

**Do not** flip recovery default, run `package:product`, or permanently relax CSP.

---

## Sequence (unchanged)

```text
peer collab test → CSS/token polish → final recovery-center gate → default cutover plan → 2.1.33 bump → package only after proof
```

---

## 1. Best test environment

### 1.1 Recommended (primary)

| Aspect | Choice | Rationale |
|--------|--------|-----------|
| Runtime | Electron from repo root (`electron .` or Playwright `_electron`) | Same as COLLAB-D; no installer |
| Renderer | **Built** `dist-renderer` (`npm run build --prefix src/renderer` first) | Matches COLLAB-D; `NODE_ENV` not `development` |
| Windows | **Two windows, one process** | One `LocalCollabSignalServer` (`main.js` L512–524, L2163–2164); shared in-memory rooms (`collab/signalServer.cjs`) |
| Profiles | **One** `NEURAL_USER_DATA_DIR` temp dir for both windows | Aligns persisted `workflowId` / session state |
| Room | Same `workflowId` string (e.g. active session id or `default`) | `useCollabRoom(String(workflowId))` in `App.jsx` L558 |
| Center shell | `USE_RECOVERY_CENTER_SHELL = true` **only during test** | Exercises MultiWorkspace publish + overlay |
| Integrity | `NEURAL_IGNORE_INTEGRITY=1` | Same as prior ui-recovery smokes |
| Collab port | Default `55116` (`NS_COLLAB_SIGNAL_PORT` optional) | Port fix **c85705e** / `listenHttpServer` retained |

### 1.2 Why not two separate Electron processes (Playwright double-launch)

Each process starts its **own** collab server (`ensureCollabSignalServer` per process). If `55116` is taken, second process may bind an ephemeral port (`signalServer.cjs` L168–168: `[preferred, 0]`). Renderers call `window.api.collab.getStatus()` on **their** main process → **different ports, different room registries**. Peers will not see each other.

**Exception (not recommended):** Manually set process B to skip starting server and point renderer at process A’s port — requires product/preload changes; out of scope for minimal test.

### 1.3 Why not `package:product` yet

Packaged app uses the same CSP injection (`main.js` L1790–1805). Installer smoke does not prove `ws://127.0.0.1:55116` unless CSP is also allowed there. Defer packaged peer proof until after local test-only CSP gate passes.

### 1.4 CSP test allowance (smallest change — execution slice, not this plan)

**No permanent CSP relaxation.**

Add a **local-only, env-gated** branch in `src/main.js` (~L1791–1795), revert after peer test:

```js
// Test-only: allow collab WebSocket when running peer verification harness
const collabTestCsp = process.env.NEURAL_COLLAB_TEST_CSP === "1";
const collabPort = Number(process.env.NS_COLLAB_SIGNAL_PORT || 55116);
const collabConnect = `ws://127.0.0.1:${collabPort}`;
const connectSrc = collabTestCsp
  ? `connect-src 'self' ${collabConnect};`
  : isDev
    ? `connect-src 'self' ws://localhost:5173 ${REACT_RENDERER_DEV_URL};`
    : "connect-src 'none';";
```

| Env | Purpose |
|-----|---------|
| `NEURAL_COLLAB_TEST_CSP=1` | Enable `connect-src` for collab WS only during peer test |
| (unset) | Production behavior unchanged |

**Approval gate:** Implement only in the peer-test execution task; remove or leave gated behind env (never set in release builds).

### 1.5 Opening the second window (harness)

`onOpenNewWindow` is **not** wired from `App.jsx` to `PrimaryWorkspaceRegion` today. Do **not** rely on MultiWorkspace “Open New Window” desktop menu for this test.

**Harness approach (Playwright, main process):**

After first window is ready, call `electronApp.evaluate()` to create a second `BrowserWindow` with the same `webPreferences` / `preload` as `createWindow()` (`main.js` L1677–1684) and `loadFile(dist-renderer/index.html)` (`main.js` L1818–1819).

Then:

```js
const pages = app.windows(); // [windowA, windowB]
```

Optional: position windows side-by-side (`setBounds`) for manual screenshot clarity.

### 1.6 Manual alternative (operator-driven)

1. Set env + flag, build renderer, `electron .`
2. Use approved test harness script to open second window (or temporary tray/menu hook — avoid unless script unavailable)
3. Dismiss onboarding on both
4. Confirm same workflow in ThreadRail on both (or both on `default`)
5. Move mouse in each window; capture screenshots

---

## 2. What to verify

### 2.1 Collab server / connection

| # | Check | Pass criteria |
|---|--------|----------------|
| S1 | Collab server starts | No `[BOOT] Fatal` / EACCES dialog; `collab:getStatus` returns `running: true`, `port` (55116 or documented fallback) |
| S2 | WS connects (both windows) | No CSP block for `ws://127.0.0.1:<port>/` in console; `collab.connected === true` in renderer probe |
| S3 | Same room | Both windows show same `collab.roomId` / TopStatusBar title room segment |

### 2.2 Peer presence (core)

| # | Check | Pass criteria |
|---|--------|----------------|
| P1 | Join same room | Both send `join` with same `room` string (`useCollabRoom.ts` L42–46) |
| P2 | Peer count | After both connected and one peer moves mouse: `collabPeerCount` on observer window **≥ 1** (`App.jsx` L559 — counts **remote** cursor keys only, not self) |
| P3 | A → B cursor | Move mouse in window A over `workspace-panel`; window B shows emerald dot + peer label overlay (`MultiWorkspace.jsx` overlay, `z-[120]`) |
| P4 | B → A cursor | Reverse of P3 |
| P5 | Publish no throw | No React page errors; no uncaught exceptions from `collab.publish` |

### 2.3 Recovery shell regression (flag true)

| # | Check | Pass criteria |
|---|--------|----------------|
| R1 | Recovery center renders | `#main-workspace`, `data-testid="workspace-panel"`, Operator Hero / layout bar |
| R2 | `/help` | Operator Guide text (not NodeChain-only stale kernel) |
| R3 | Freeform send | No crash; user message visible |
| R4 | Layout presets | hud / compact / balanced / wide clickable |
| R5 | Command palette | `command-palette-btn` opens palette |

### 2.4 Post-test safe default

| # | Check | Pass criteria |
|---|--------|----------------|
| F1 | Flag restored | `USE_RECOVERY_CENTER_SHELL = false` |
| F2 | Old shell | Legacy `WorkspacePanel` path still has `collab={collab}`; smoke optional with flag false |
| F3 | CSP gate off | `NEURAL_COLLAB_TEST_CSP` unset; no permanent `main.js` widening |

### 2.5 Explicit non-goals (this test)

- `thread-reply` publish / ingest (deferred)
- VoicePanel collab
- Real WAN / multi-machine peers
- Default recovery center cutover

---

## 3. How to avoid unsafe changes

| Rule | Action |
|------|--------|
| No `package:product` | Use `electron .` + built `dist-renderer` only |
| No permanent CSP change | `NEURAL_COLLAB_TEST_CSP=1` only during run; revert env gate commit if merged |
| No default flag flip | `USE_RECOVERY_CENTER_SHELL=true` temporary in `App.jsx`; restore `false` before reporting done |
| No collab server rewrite | Do not edit `collab/signalServer.cjs` except if EACCES on port (document port/env) |
| No installer / Programs 2.1.32 | Do not touch installed copy |
| Minimal source touch | Allowed: temporary flag; optional gated CSP in `main.js`; harness script under `validation-artifacts/ui-recovery/` only |
| Port fix preserved | Keep `listenHttpServer` / **c85705e** behavior |

---

## 4. Evidence to capture

**Directory:** `validation-artifacts\ui-recovery\phase-1f-collab-peer-test\`

| Artifact | Filename pattern | Content |
|----------|------------------|---------|
| Screenshot A sees B’s cursor | `01-window-a-shows-remote-cursor-<stamp>.png` | Window A focused; B’s dot visible |

# PEER-CURSOR-DIAG — 1F-C-COLLAB-PEER-CURSOR-DIAG

**Captured:** 2026-05-18  
**Branch:** `feat/renderer-recovery-232`  
**Flag during test:** `USE_RECOVERY_CENTER_SHELL=true` (restored `false` after)  
**Transport:** PEER-FIX verified (dynamic localhost collab WS port allowed)

## Summary

Cursor exchange **works end-to-end** on the recovery `MultiWorkspace` path when both windows share one Electron process and the observer window is allowed to paint. The PEER-FIX run showing **peer count 0** and **no dots** was a **false negative** caused by probing the **background** window before React committed `remoteCursors` / status-bar UI.

**Root cause classification: H** (harness / timing — background observer window not brought to front before probe).

No product code fix required for publish, server broadcast, hook receive, or overlay rendering. The peer test harness should `bringToFront()` on the observer before reading peer count / DOM dots.

## Evidence map

| Check | Result |
|-------|--------|
| MultiWorkspace `mousemove` fires | **Yes** — `mw-publish` logs; Playwright moves inside `workspace-panel` bbox |
| `collab.publish('cursor', …)` called | **Yes** — `publish-cursor` logs; `ok: true` |
| Payload shape | `{ x: number, y: number }` (clientX/clientY) — matches `WorkspacePanel` |
| Server receives cursor | **Yes** — `server-cursor.log` `publish-cursor` events |
| Server broadcasts to peer | **Yes** — `roomSize: 2`, `broadcastCount: 1` |
| Peer renderer receives | **Yes** — `ws-cursor-in` on observer console |
| `remoteCursors` updates | **Yes** after observer `bringToFront()` |
| Overlay DOM | **Yes** — `remoteCursorDotCount: 1`, emerald dot in screenshot |
| Peer count logic | **Correct** — `Object.keys(collab.remoteCursors).length`; counts remote peers only |

## Runs

1. **Without observer focus** — `cursor-diag-report-2026-05-18T03-27-22.json`  
   - B logged many `ws-cursor-in` events while A moved.  
   - `probeBAfterA`: peer count **0**, `remoteCursors: {}` (B still backgrounded).  
   - After B moved and A was probed: A showed **1 peer**, **1 dot**.

2. **With `pageB.bringToFront()` before probe** — `cursor-diag-report-2026-05-18T03-30-01.json`  
   - `probeBAfterA`: **1 peer**, `remoteCursorDotCount: 1`, `remoteCursors` populated.  
   - Classification: **PASS** (full pipeline).

## Server sample (both peers in room)

```json
{"event":"join","roomId":"NeuralShell_QuickStart","peerId":"peer-…","roomSize":2}
{"event":"publish-cursor","roomId":"NeuralShell_QuickStart","fromPeerId":"peer-…","payload":{"x":640,"y":360},"roomSize":2,"broadcastCount":1}
```

## Smallest recommended fix

**Harness only** (no renderer/server change for cursor pipeline):

1. After moving mouse on the publisher window, `await observerPage.bringToFront()` and wait ~500ms.
2. Poll `collab-status-pill` title / `remoteCursorDotCount` with timeout (existing `waitForRemoteCursor`).
3. Optionally dispatch `MouseEvent('mousemove')` on `[data-testid=workspace-panel]` in addition to Playwright `mouse.move` (already helps).

Update: `_tmp-1f-collab-peer-test.cjs` and `_tmp-1f-collab-peer-cursor-diag.cjs` include `bringToFront` on observer.

## Not the cause

- **A** — mousemove not firing (ruled out)  
- **B/C** — publish not called / wrong shape (ruled out)  
- **D** — server drop / no broadcast (ruled out when both joined)  
- **E** — hook not updating state (ruled out when observer focused)  
- **F** — overlay invisible (ruled out; dot visible when state committed)  
- **G** — peer count ignores cursor peers (ruled out; design is remote-cursor keys only)

## Artifacts

- `cursor-diag-report-2026-05-18T03-27-22.json` — background-probe false negative  
- `cursor-diag-report-2026-05-18T03-30-01.json` — PASS with `bringToFront`  
- `server-cursor.log` / `server-cursor-copy-*.log`  
- `renderer-logs-a-*.json`, `renderer-logs-b-*.json`  
- `recovery-multiworkspace-window-*-*.png` screenshots

# Phase 1G — UI polish inventory (plan only)

**Branch:** `feat/renderer-recovery-232`  
**Locked reference:** `validation-artifacts/ui-recovery/LOCKED-GOOD-UI-232/neuralshell-232-main-shell-20260517.png` (NeuralShell **v2.1.32**, May 2 build)  
**Recovery evidence:** `phase-1f-c3d-recovery-center-smoke/01-initial-2026-05-17T23-39-26.png`, `phase-1f-collab-d-smoke/01-initial-2026-05-18T01-23-10.png`, `phase-1f-c3b-recovery-center-visual/phase-1fc3b-center-2026-05-17T22-17-24.png`  
**Constraint:** No CSS edits in this slice. `USE_RECOVERY_CENTER_SHELL` stays **false** until visual + send + collab gates pass.

---

## Executive summary

The recovery center path is **functionally alive** (clock, HUD/Dense/Standard/Spacious, Operator Hero, Control Deck, send, collab). Visual parity with locked **2.1.32** is incomplete mainly because:

1. **Missing May 2 token/CSS utilities** (`ui-holo-panel`, `ui-tactile`, richer `bg-shell-canvas`) — classes are referenced in JSX but **not defined** in current `src/renderer/src/index.css` (definitions exist only in `asar-full-release-232/src/renderer/src/index.css`).
2. **Composition / scroll** — recovery smoke shows chat-first pane content; locked reference shows Hero + Control Deck + Execution Confidence as the **dominant center column** without scrolling past them.
3. **Top bar layout** — recovery merged clock/collab but lacks locked center nav cluster density and exact chrome weights.

Polish should be **sliced token → component class → layout**, not ad-hoc color tweaks.

---

## Comparison matrix (10 categories)

### 1. Top bar spacing / chrome

| | Locked 2.1.32 | Recovery (c3d/collab-d smoke) |
|--|----------------|-------------------------------|
| Evidence | `neuralshell-232-main-shell-20260517.png` | `phase-1f-c3d-recovery-center-smoke/01-initial-*.png` |
| Behavior | Taller bar; center nav links (Search, Graph, Projects…); version as subtle mono `v2.1.32`; holo clock integrated right | `TopStatusBar` h-14, holo clock present, collab pill, workflow chip; **no** center nav cluster; runtime pills (WATCHDOG, EXEC) visible |
| Likely source | `TopStatusBar.jsx`, possibly `OperationsCoreLayer` nav | `TopStatusBar.jsx` (recovery merge) |
| Fix owner | **TopStatusBar** (+ optional thin nav strip if product wants locked links) | |
| Risk | Medium — collab/clock must not regress | |
| Smallest slice | **1G-A:** TopStatusBar padding, border/shadow tokens, version typography only (no nav scope creep) |

### 2. Background / canvas color

| | Locked | Recovery |
|--|--------|----------|
| Evidence | Deep navy canvas, subtle radial depth behind hero | `bg-shell-canvas` on `MultiWorkspace` root; flatter panel grays |
| Behavior | Unified dark canvas with violet/cyan ambient gradients | Tailwind `shell-canvas` token exists in `tailwind.config.js` but **ambient gradients weaker** |
| Likely source | `index.css` / `ui-enhancements.css`, `MoodBackdrop.jsx`, `MultiWorkspace.jsx` | |
| Fix owner | **index.css tokens** first, then **MoodBackdrop** opacity | |
| Risk | Medium — global background affects legacy `WorkspacePanel` when flag false | |
| Smallest slice | **1G-B:** Port only `--shell-canvas` + body/root background from asar `index.css` (scoped test with flag true) |

### 3. Holo panel / token styles

| | Locked | Recovery |
|--|--------|----------|
| Evidence | Glass holo cards on Hero, Control Deck, Execution Confidence | JSX uses `ui-holo-panel`, `ui-tactile` in `MultiWorkspace.jsx`, `CapabilitiesMatrix.jsx` |
| Behavior | Visible glass border, inner highlight, hover sheen | **Classes likely no-op** — `.ui-holo-panel` **not in current** `src/renderer/src/index.css` (present in asar recovery CSS) |
| Likely source | `asar-full-release-232/src/renderer/src/index.css` L307+ | |
| Fix owner | **index.css** (+ `ui-enhancements.css` import if needed) | |
| Risk | High if bundled with full Tailwind v4 migration | |
| Smallest slice | **1G-C:** Copy **only** `.ui-holo-panel`, `.ui-tactile`, related `::before` rules into current index.css (no vite/tailwind bump in same PR) |

### 4. Operator Hero Console size / position

| | Locked | Recovery |
|--|--------|----------|
| Evidence | Large centered hero: icon, `Operator Hero Console` ~2rem, subcopy, `Launch proof lane` / `Run security sweep` | `MultiWorkspace.jsx` `PaneEmptyState` has hero block; c3b center shot shows **chat mentor UI** instead — hero may be below fold or pane not empty |
| Behavior | Hero is **first** visual anchor in center | Recovery often lands in **pane chat** with Concept mentor + suggested prompts |
| Likely source | `MultiWorkspace.jsx` (`PaneEmptyState` vs `PaneChat`), pane hydration | |
| Fix owner | **MultiWorkspace** layout / default pane empty state | |
| Risk | Low–medium — send path must stay on `preferAppSend` | |
| Smallest slice | **1G-D:** Ensure default pane shows `PaneEmptyState` hero before first message; reduce chat chrome until user sends |

### 5. Control Deck spacing / cards

| | Locked | Recovery |
|--|--------|----------|
| Evidence | Wide Control Deck + Execution Confidence side-by-side, 4 action tiles | `CapabilitiesMatrix.jsx` implements deck; may be **below fold** in smoke |
| Behavior | Deck visible without scroll at typical 900px height | Smoke shows workbench/right rails consuming vertical space |
| Likely source | `CapabilitiesMatrix.jsx`, `PrimaryWorkspaceRegion.jsx` flex | |
| Fix owner | **PrimaryWorkspaceRegion** + **CapabilitiesMatrix** | |
| Risk | Medium | |
| Smallest slice | **1G-E:** Capabilities matrix sticky/min-height in center column; tighten grid gaps via component classes |

### 6. Rail proportions

| | Locked | Recovery |
|--|--------|----------|
| Evidence | Balanced thread/workbench; center dominates in HUD | HUD preset works functionally; rails still feel heavier than locked |
| Behavior | HUD = minimal rail width | `RAIL_SIZE_PRESETS.hud` in `App.jsx`; `LayoutControlBar` applies presets |
| Likely source | `App.jsx`, `PrimaryWorkspaceRegion.jsx`, `LayoutControlBar.jsx` | |
| Fix owner | **LayoutControlBar** + **App** preset constants | |
| Risk | Low | |
| Smallest slice | **1G-F:** Tune `RAIL_SIZE_PRESETS.hud/compact` numbers to match locked screenshot pixel widths |

### 7. Typography scale

| | Locked | Recovery |
|--|--------|----------|
| Evidence | Hero 2rem semibold; deck headers 11px uppercase; confidence 30px score | Recovery uses similar Tailwind scales but flatter contrast |
| Likely source | Component classNames | |
| Fix owner | **MultiWorkspace**, **CapabilitiesMatrix**, **TopStatusBar** | |
| Risk | Low | |
| Smallest slice | **1G-G:** Typography pass on hero + deck headers only (component classes) |

### 8. Borders / glow / shadows

| | Locked | Recovery |
|--|--------|----------|
| Evidence | Cyan/violet edge glows, soft drop shadows on deck | Partial inline shadows on `CapabilitiesMatrix`; missing holo `::before` layers |
| Likely source | **index.css** holo utilities + component shadows | |
| Fix owner | **index.css** then components | |
| Risk | Medium | |
| Smallest slice | Same as **1G-C** (holo tokens) |

### 9. Layout density

| | Locked | Recovery |
|--|--------|----------|
| Evidence | HUD mode very tight; hero + deck visible together | Recovery HUD works; vertical stacking pushes deck down |
| Likely source | PWR flex column, pane tabs, first-boot / workbench rails | |
| Fix owner | **PrimaryWorkspaceRegion** | |
| Risk | Medium | |
| Smallest slice | **1G-H:** Center column `min-h-0` + hero/deck `shrink-0` flex ordering |

### 10. Missing May 2 CSS tokens / classes

| Token / class | In recovery JSX? | In current `index.css`? | In asar 2.1.32 CSS? |
|---------------|------------------|-------------------------|---------------------|
| `ui-holo-panel` | Yes | **No** | Yes |
| `ui-tactile` | Yes | **No** | Yes |
| `bg-shell-canvas` | Yes | Partial (tailwind) | Yes |
| `bg-shell-soft` | TopStatusBar | tailwind opacity only | Yes |
| `text-gradient` / brand motion | Partial | Minimal | Yes |

**Fix owner:** **index.css** (+ optional `styles/ui-enhancements.css`) — **not** vite.config until planned (Phase 1A item 23–24).

---

## Top 3 safest polish slices (recommended order)

| Priority | Slice | Why safe |
|----------|-------|----------|
| **1** | **1G-C** — Port `.ui-holo-panel` / `.ui-tactile` only from asar CSS | Pure CSS additive; immediately fixes deck/hero glass without layout moves |
| **2** | **1G-A** — TopStatusBar spacing/chrome | Isolated component; clock/collab already proven |
| **3** | **1G-F** — Rail preset width tuning | Constants only; HUD/Dense already wired |

## Deferred / higher risk (do not start in 1G first PR)

- Full `index.css` / Tailwind v4 migration (`vite.config.js`, renderer `package.json`) — **explicitly out of scope** per user guardrails.
- Center nav cluster restoration (Search, Graph, …) — product decision; not required for May 2 parity proof in port map.
- Default flag cutover (`USE_RECOVERY_CENTER_SHELL=true`) — after 1G visual gate + peer proof + send smoke.
